Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 11
Reason for Mistake: After being instructed to scan the video for moments with multiple bird species and take screenshots, WebSurfer scrolled the comments instead of playing/scrubbing the video to capture relevant frames and timestamps. This failure to gather any evidence stalled progress and led to an unsupported final answer of “2,” despite the video showing at least three species simultaneously (emperor penguin chicks, an Adélie penguin, and a giant petrel).
